tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Search for GitHub repositories by name, description, or topic keywords using the GitHub Search API.

params.name: q
params.description: Keyword to search in repository names, descriptions, or topics

tools.name: view_repo
tools.description: View repository basic information and its directory structure. Includes corresponding documentation repo if available.

tools.name: list_tree
tools.description: List the directory tree of a specific path in a repository with customizable depth and traversal limits.

params.name: maxDepth
params.description: Maximum depth into the directory structure to list.

params.name: maxPerDir
params.description: Maximum number of items to display per directory level.

params.name: targetDir
params.description: Target directory path to inspect. Leaves empty to search from root.

tools.name: read_code
tools.description: Retrieve the raw source code of specified files from within a known repository.

params.name: paths
params.description: An array of precise file paths within the repository

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Perform a fast git grep inside the repository, allowing regex matching by default or substring search.

params.name: path
params.description: Directory or file path to limit the search scope

params.name: query
params.description: Search pattern or query to pass to git grep

params.name: ignoreCase
params.description: Ignore case distinctions in both the PATTERN and the input files (-i)

params.name: contextLines
params.description: Print num lines of output context (-C)

params.name: fixedStrings
params.description: Use fixed strings for patterns (don’t interpret pattern as a regex) (-F)
